periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree downward tilt relative to the horizontal facial axis towards the snout
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval, with a vertical axis significantly longer than the horizontal width
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering where the lowest point extends significantly below the geometric center

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shaped curve along the posterior boundary of the band

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semicircular convex curvature at the top of the ear boundaries

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-brown tint or staining on the fur of the hindquarters and posterior dorsal region compared to the white cranial fur
